name: Momentum Top-3 EM Equity + 15% Vol Target
description: Selects the top 3 assets by 12-month trailing return from the emerging-market equity universe (India, China A-shares, EM IMI ESG screened, UBS Core MSCI EM), weights by inverse volatility, then scales to 15% annualised volatility. Rotates across EM regional/style leadership rather than a single blended EM fund.
